messages:
maya: Quick postmortem follow-up for Delta's on-prem peering outage — want to capture actionable remediation and owners. Root cause was an onprem NAT/firewall rule rollback + BGP session flapping during maintenance window. Need owners, timelines, and a plan to prevent recurrence.

alex: Got it. Can you paste the minimal RCA summary we gave the customer so I can sync with sales/AM?

maya: Sure. Short version: during their router config change, BGP session briefly dropped. Our peering healthcheck retried but hit a stale route in their NAT, causing asymmetric paths and session timeouts. A concurrent automation rollback removed a firewall rule for the peer CIDR for ~7 minutes.

leo: Action suggestions: 1) Add a pre-change checklist for onprem peering (owner: leo, due: 2026-04-10) 2) Harden healthcheck to detect asymmetric path (owner: alex, due: 2026-04-17) 3) Add explicit staged rollback guard for firewall automation (owner: tom, due: 2026-04-08). Will take ownership of (1).

serena: For the firewall automation guard, can we have a quick snippet or policy check to fail if a rule removal affects active peer CIDRs? I can add to the infra repo.

maya: Yup — adding proposed check below. Use this in the PR for the automation repo: 

```bash
# pre-change check pseudocode
PEER_CIDR=10.45.0.0/21
if iptables-save | grep -q "$PEER_CIDR"; then
  echo "peer cidr exists, safe to proceed"
else
  echo "ERROR: peer cidr absent, aborting change"
  exit 1
fi
```

infra-bot: Created incident ticket INC-4268 and linked to postmortem: https://tracker.example.com/INC-4268 :ticket:

tom: I'll own the automation guard change and add a deploy-time confirmation gate. Targeting 2026-04-08 EOD. I'll also add a canary step to prevent whole-cluster rule churn.

alex: I'll own the healthcheck hardening. Plan: augment probe to verify symmetric path and add a second-path fallback. ETA 2026-04-17. I'll open PR and ping for review.

leo: For (1) checklist: will add a new section to the onprem runbook titled "Peering maintenance preflight" with explicit steps: (a) verify BGP neighbors stable (b) validate NAT table for peer CIDRs (c) schedule change in customer maintenance window (d) notify ops + AM. Will link to runbook PR by 2026-04-10.

serena: Also propose adding a recurring label in the tracker to capture pattern: "peering-flap:monthly" or similar so we can detect customers with repeat flaps. If we see >2 in 90 days, auto-escalate to Platform Eng review.

maya: Agreed. Please add that label to INC-4268. Also adding a separate ticket for customer communication: CC-1932 (customer update + follow-up plan). I'll handle that with AM.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: automation-guard v1.1 -> staging on 2026-04-06 03:00 UTC, production 2026-04-08 02:00 UTC.

tom: Noted on deploy times, will coordinate rollback windows.

alex: One more ask — add a minimal test harness to replicate asymmetric path locally (small script + BGP session flapping sim) so QA can validate healthcheck. Will draft tests by 2026-04-12.

maya: Thanks all. Recap of owners/dates: leo (preflight checklist) 2026-04-10, tom (automation guard) 2026-04-08, alex (healthcheck + tests) 2026-04-17/2026-04-12, serena (repo PR + label) 2026-04-06. infra-bot created INC-4268. I've added CC-1932 for customer comms. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you've read and accepted.

leo: :white_check_mark:

tom: :white_check_mark:

alex: :white_check_mark: will open PRs today

serena: :white_check_mark: adding label now

maya: Closing thread for now — will follow-up in INC-4268 and the runbook PRs. If anything slips, flag here or DM. :eyes:
